question: What is the current active headcount of my organisation?
correct_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.assoc_id) AS active_n FROM `my-project.hr.emp_period_snapshot` s JOIN `my-project.hr.pay_period_dim` p ON p.ppe_dt = s.period_end_dt AND p.freq_cd = 'B' WHERE p.is_current_flag AND s.snap_dt = s.period_end_dt AND s.status_cd = 'A' AND {manager_id} IN (s.lvl_2_id, s.lvl_3_id, s.lvl_4_id, s.lvl_2_id_fn, s.lvl_3_id_fn, s.lvl_4_id_fn)

question: Active headcount of my organisation for each of the last {n} pay periods
correct_sql: SELECT p.period_seq, p.ppe_dt AS period_end_dt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(s.status_cd = 'A', s.assoc_id, NULL)) AS active_n FROM `my-project.hr.pay_period_dim` p LEFT JOIN `my-project.hr.emp_period_snapshot` s ON s.period_end_dt = p.ppe_dt AND s.snap_dt = p.ppe_dt AND {manager_id} IN (s.lvl_2_id, s.lvl_3_id, s.lvl_4_id, s.lvl_2_id_fn, s.lvl_3_id_fn, s.lvl_4_id_fn) WHERE p.freq_cd = 'B' AND p.period_seq BETWEEN -({n}-1) AND 0 GROUP BY p.period_seq, p.ppe_dt ORDER BY p.period_seq
